title: Austin Spending Review Kicks Off
summary:
*   A special city committee convened to launch a review of Austin's services and expenditures.
*   Key city council members were present for this important financial oversight meeting.
*   The session marked the beginning of efforts to assess city operations and resource allocation.

Memorandum To:
The special called meeting of the Council's Select Committee on Services and Spending was
called to order.

Humphrey.
A tape recording of the meeting is on file in the City Clerk's office. Minutes of the
meeting are on file in the office of the Assistant City Manager, Gary Hunt.
